::: {.proto-facts}
Status
: [In production]{.proto-status .s-prod}

What it is
: Your login for BigPicture. LS AAI (Life Science Login) lets you sign in with an account you already have, at your university, research institute or a commercial provider, linked to one Life Science ID.

Who it's for
: Data contributors, data users, and administrators and support staff.

Provided by
: Life Science RI (operated by Masaryk University). Set up for BigPicture by CSC.

Before you start
: An account at your institution, a research organisation or a commercial provider.

How to get access
: 1. [Create a Life Science ID](https://www.lifescience-ri.eu/ls-login-and-registration-guide/).
  2. Check your details in [your profile](https://profile.aai.lifescience-ri.eu/profile).
  3. Ask your organisation's Perun manager to add you to its [Perun](perun.qmd) group.

Guides
: - [Registration guide](https://www.lifescience-ri.eu/ls-login-and-registration-guide/)
  - LS AAI user guide [(SharePoint, members)]{.text-muted}

Terms and privacy
: [Acceptable usage policy](https://www.lifescience-ri.eu/acceptable-usage-policy-and-conditions-of-use/) · [Privacy notice](https://www.lifescience-ri.eu/ls-login-privacy-notice/)

Support
: ::: {.proto-support provider="CSC" owner="[Name], CSC" second="[Name], CSC" external="Login problems can also go straight to the LS Login helpdesk: support@aai.lifescience-ri.eu (Mon–Fri 08:00–16:00 CET)." hours="best effort"}
  :::

Related services
: [Perun](perun.qmd), [REMS](rems.qmd), [Repository](repository.qmd), [Discovery](discovery.qmd), [Cytomine](../models/access/cytomine.qmd)

[In production]{.proto-status .s-prod}

[LS AAI (Life Science Login) is your login for BigPicture. Sign in with an account you already have and use one identity across all BigPicture services.]{.proto-lead}

::: {.proto-strip}
**For** data contributors, data users, support staff

**Provided by** Life Science RI, set up for BigPicture by CSC
:::

::: {.proto-cta}
[Create a Life Science ID](https://www.lifescience-ri.eu/ls-login-and-registration-guide/)
:::

## Before you start

You need an account at your university, research institute or a commercial provider.

## How to get access

1. [Create a Life Science ID](https://www.lifescience-ri.eu/ls-login-and-registration-guide/).
2. Check your details in [your profile](https://profile.aai.lifescience-ri.eu/profile).
3. Ask your organisation's Perun manager to add you to its [Perun](perun.qmd) group. No Perun manager yet? Ask the Service Desk.

## Guides

- [Registration guide](https://www.lifescience-ri.eu/ls-login-and-registration-guide/)
- LS AAI user guide [(SharePoint, members)]{.text-muted}

<!-- ============ C: Task-first (loose) — what can I do, side box with facts ============ -->
::: {.proto-v v="C"}
::: {.proto-split}
::: {}
One login for every BigPicture service. You bring an account you already have, and LS AAI links it to a single Life Science ID.

::: {.proto-tasks}
::: {}
#### Get a login
[Create a Life Science ID](https://www.lifescience-ri.eu/ls-login-and-registration-guide/) with your institution's account.
:::

::: {}
#### Join your organisation
Your Perun manager adds you to your organisation's [Perun](perun.qmd) group.
:::

::: {}
#### Can't sign in?
See the [support](#support-c) section below.
:::
:::

After you've joined, the same login opens [REMS](rems.qmd), [Discovery](discovery.qmd), [Cytomine](../models/access/cytomine.qmd) and your upload and download credentials in the [Repository](repository.qmd).

:::
:::
